'''Richard Marquand''' (22 September 1937 – 4 September 1987) was a Welsh film and television director, best known for directing ''Return of the Jedi'' (1983). He has a cameo in that film as "Maj. Marquand".<ref name="wp-marquand">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Richard_Marquand Richard Marquand], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026024957/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Richard_Marquand Internet Archive], 26 October 2026.</ref>

The [[Endor (expansion)|Endor]] card [[Major Marquand]] has the lore "Directed a counterattack against the Ewoks on Endor." The line refers to Marquand, who directed ''Return of the Jedi'' and appears in it as an AT-ST driver.<ref name="encyc199">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 199. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive], 8 October 2026.</ref>
